title: Bayesian inference of planted matchings: Local posterior approximation and infinite-volume limit
summary: We study Bayesian inference of an unknown matching $π^*$ between two correlated random point sets $\{X_i\}_{i=1}^n$ and $\{Y_i\}_{i=1}^n$ in $[0,1]^d$, under a critical scaling $\|X_i-Y_{π^*(i)}\|_2 \asymp n^{-1/d}$, in both an exact matching model where all points are observed and a partial matching model where a fraction of points may be missing.
